theory_state.status: FROZEN — no theory changes during the observational campaign
theory_state.ladder: L=6,12,20,42 all strict null over Re[0.05,3.0] x Im[-2.0,-0.05]

nicer.cleaning: cleaned event files, PI 35..900 (unchanged from G184)

nicer_protocol.lightcurve: per GTI segment >= 16 s, dt = 1/64 s
nicer_protocol.detection: model-independent: all local maxima of the averaged PSD with power above the chi2_2 noise floor are pre-candidates; threshold = Leahy 2 + 6 sigma (sigma = 2/sqrt(n_avg)) recorded but candidates BELOW threshold are ALSO catalogued down to 4 sigma, labeled below_6sigma
nicer_protocol.characterization_after_detection: Lorentzian fit allowed ONLY as data description (frequency, width, Q); NOT an SSZ fit

blind_split.rule: odd/even SHA256(ObsID) split, deterministic, computed before candidate interpretation
blind_split.discovery: candidates defined on discovery ObsIDs only
blind_split.validation: frozen candidate frequencies/bands tested on validation ObsIDs; frequencies never moved after validation

gwosc_protocol.no_templates: no Kerr QNM frequencies, no SSZ frequencies, no remnant-mass window
gwosc_protocol.whitening: PSD whitening from off-source data (same method for H1 and L1)
gwosc_protocol.analysis_window: post-merger interval [gps_event + 0.002 s, gps_event + 0.06 s] frozen BEFORE extraction (covers the declared ringdown window without any theory input)
gwosc_protocol.extraction: matrix-pencil (Prony) damped-mode extraction on whitened complex strain, H1 and L1 INDEPENDENTLY

stability.requirement: mode must persist across >= 2 start and >= 2 end settings with frequency drift < 5%

coherence_gate.phase_consistency: time-delay corrected phase consistent within 2 pi / (f * tau) budget
coherence_gate.false_alarm: candidate exceeds the 99th percentile of the off-source null distribution built from the frozen off-source segments

mass_rule: NO mass chosen or inferred in this campaign. NICER frequencies stay in Hz. GWOSC modes stay in f/tau/Q detector convention. Any later mass mapping uses an externally frozen dynamical mass prior (NICER) or inspiral-only frozen scale (GWOSC), never the post-merger segment being validated.
no_retuning_rule: No theory rerun, retuning or new scan motivated by observed features. Any such idea becomes a NEW preregistered hypothesis with holdout data.
